$comment: Exponential Desktop's factory settings (#EDE-47, the merged Settings window of the IDE look): #EDE-65: Settings open INTO the sidebar like the IDE's: one on-demand top layer over the rail and the ground, above the taskbar (the menu's Settings rows open it with ede_open_document, the close button closes it): the settings nav takes the sidebar's place, wider while open (shell-layout.json settingsWidth 272, the IDE's settings column, on the same black), and the page sits on the ground's rounded panel (panelMargin 10, panelRadius 12, the ground's fill), no tile overview. The nav: This device (Display, Sound, Network, Bluetooth, Power, Themes, Keyboard, Mouse & Touchpad, Date & Time, Users, Notifications, Workspaces, Windows, Startup apps, Default apps, then the folded Coding group: Tools, Coding CLIs, Worktrees, Sessions, the IDE's This device group), Personal (Account, Devices, Security, What's new, About) and Team, headed by the shell's switcher (/shell/switcher/current; its sections as a Popover: Local desktops, then one per connected account with its teams, #EDE-56): a Local desktop shows General, Agents, Apps; a team entry shows the IDE's groups from settings-nav.json (Team, Boards, Agents, Apps), which eDE has none of yet (#EDE-54). Picking an entry here sets /settings/team only: the shell's desktop stays. Pages bind what the shell feeds: /services/<domain> (#EDE-13), /outputs, /config, /user, /shell, /date, /notifications, and /pages (#EDE-47: the layouts, Date & Time, Startup apps, Default apps, Workspaces, Windows, Mouse & Touchpad). Controls are two-way bound and call a host function with the new value: ede_service {domain, action, args}, ede_output {name, mode?, scale?}, ede_config {theme}, ede_settings {page, key, value} (compositor.toml's [keyboard] and [windows], the XDG autostart overrides, xdg-mime default, timedatectl). A setting the machine cannot apply yet is a read-only value row (Mouse & Touchpad, the workspace count, the 24-hour clock), never a dead control; the Exponential rows (Notifications' email/push, Coding, Devices, Security, a team's pages) are honest empty states until the Exponential app runs on this desktop. #EDE-57: a Local desktop's General page shares it as a team: Share as a team… asks for the team name and, with several accounts, the account (ede_share {action: start|run|cancel, name?, account?}; the host feeds /sharing {state idle|needsAccount|picking|running|done|failed, accounts, summary, progress, label, teamName, error}), uploads through the team import API and the desktop becomes that team (archived here for 30 days).
